defs.def: the leader of a republic, especially the US 总统；国家主席

ex.s: "Ding" Darling, a political cartoonist from Des Moines, Iowa, who at that time was appointed by President Franklin Roosevelt as Director of the Bureau of Biological Survey.
ex.t: "丁"·达林(英語：Ding),艾奥瓦州得梅因斯的政治漫画家，他当时被总统富兰克林·罗斯福任命为生物调查局局长。

ex.s: After Lincoln was elected President of the US in 1861, they rented the house and   65   （sell）most of their furniture.
ex.t: 1861年林肯当选美国总统后，他们租了房子并____65____（sell）了大部分家具。

ex.s: Asking a favor of the President of the United States was no casual matter, especially for a seventeen-year-old girl.
ex.t: 请美国总统帮个忙绝非小事，对一个17岁的女孩来说尤其如此。

ex.s: Before Vinnie could say yes, the President hurried on, a shade of apology in his voice.
ex.t: 温妮还没来得及答应，总统便匆匆继续说，声音里带着一丝歉意。

ex.s: The President's eyes, brightened at her show of spirit.
ex.t: 总统的眼睛在她的精神表演中亮了起来。

ex.s: The President seemed to consider her idea seriously.
ex.t: "如果我把黏土带到这里，每天下午工作三小时，我可以在你在办公桌前工作时完成大部分项目。"

ex.s: The very next day, Vinnie received an invitation from the President.
ex.t: 我不能立即做出决定，但你很快会收到我的消息。"

ex.t: 是什么让薇妮有信心向林肯总统提出请求？（    ）

ex.s: President Lincoln's gentle voice.
ex.t: 林肯总统温柔的声音。

ex.s: How did President Lincoln first respond to Vinnie's request? （    ）
ex.t: 林肯总统最初如何回应薇妮的请求？（    ）

ex.t: 从一个直角观察总统

ex.t: 以合适的角度观察总统

ex.s: Whaley got the idea of this second-grade presidential campaign project when he asked the children one day to raise their hands if they thought they could never be a president.
ex.t: 有一天，惠利问孩子们：如果觉得自己永远当不上总统就举手。他由此萌生了开展这个二年级“总统竞选”项目的想法。

ex.s: Knowledgeable guides will entertain you with the most, interesting stories about Presidents, Congress, memorials, and parks.
ex.t: 知识渊博的导游会用关于总统、国会、纪念碑和公园最有趣的故事逗你开心。

ex.s: With this little joke, Lin was able to make people laugh, while gently telling off the president.
ex.t: 通过这个小玩笑，林既能让人们发笑，又能温和地批评总统。

ex.s: With this little joke, Lin was able to make people laugh and to criticise the president in a subtle way.
ex.t: 通过这个小玩笑，林既能让人们发笑，又能以一种含蓄的方式批评总统。

ex.s: The man was Abraham Lincoln, President of the United States of America, and he was there in memory of the soldiers who had died.
ex.t: 那个人是亚伯拉罕\u00b7林肯，美利坚合众国的总统，他到场是为了纪念死去的士兵。

ex.s: Country Is Coping With Oil Shortage The President has announced emergency measures to limit fuel consumption.
ex.t: 国家正在应对石油短缺总统宣布了限制燃料消耗的紧急措施。

defs.def: the person in charge of some organizations, clubs, colleges, etc. （机构、俱乐部、学院等的）负责人，会长，院长，主席

ex.s: Michael Kelsey Paris, vice president of the Oklahoma Cattlemen's Association, said a robot could be extremely useful given rising concerns about cattle theft.
ex.t: 俄克拉荷马养牛人协会副主席迈克尔·凯尔西·帕里斯表示，鉴于对偷牛行为的担忧日益增加，机器人可能非常有用。

ex.s: Once, having been invited to dinner at a university, he was put on the spot when the president suddenly asked him to give a speech.
ex.t: 有一次，他被邀请到一所大学赴宴，当校长突然请他发表演讲时，他被弄得很尴尬。

defs.def: the person in charge of a bank or a commercial organization 银行行长；总经理；董事长；总裁

ex.s: “I [had] lost enough sleep over this,” says David Cox, the company's Western region vice president — and that was before the hospital mentioned the tree's distinguished origin.
ex.t: “我为此已经失眠够多了，”该公司西区副总裁David Cox说——而且那还是在医院提到这棵树显赫的来历之前。
